+## Checks (every publish, on both sites)
+
+Both sites drop input without saying so: a 简介 that never reached the form, a tag that vanished, a cover made
+from a blank frame, the previous video still selected in the file dialog, a 标记 lost when the video was
+swapped. So a publish is not done when the button is clicked. It is done when every check below has passed
+against what the site actually stored. Report each one to the user; anything that failed or was skipped is
+said plainly.
+
+**1. Before opening the upload pages,** write the B站 简介 and the 小红书 body to files and run:
+
+```bash
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/publish_check.py --video ~/Desktop/小红书上传/NN_<slug>.mp4 \
+    --render $P/renders/video.mp4 --cover ~/Desktop/小红书上传/NN_<slug>_封面_B站.png \
+    --bili-title "<B站标题>" --xhs-title "<小红书标题>" --bili-desc desc.txt --xhs-body body.txt
+```
+
+Fix every ✗ first. Note the duration and both text lengths it prints; the later checks compare against them.
+
+**2. B站, before 立即投稿:** run this in the page and compare each field with the draft.
+
+```js
+const t = document.body.innerText;
+({ title: document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="标题"]').value,
+   uploaded: t.match(/[^\n]*上传完成/g),                         // file name + 上传完成
+   desc: t.match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*2000/)?.[1],                     // == draft length, never 0
+   declare: document.querySelector('input[placeholder="请选择符合您视频内容的创作声明"]')?.value,
+   zone: t.match(/分区\n\n([^\n]*)/)?.[1],                       // 人工智能
+   tags: t.match(/标签\n\n([\s\S]*?)\n\n还可以添加/)?.[1].split('\n\n'),  // the drafted tags, no auto tags
+   collection: t.match(/合集\n([^\n]*)\n清除/)?.[1] })
+```
+
+The uploaded file name must be this video's (`NN_<slug>`), and the auto-filled title before you replaced it
+must have been that name too. The cover dialog's two `x/vu/web/cover/up` responses must both be 200.
+
+**3. B站, after 稿件投递成功:** read what was stored.
+
+```js
+const a = (await fetch('https://member.bilibili.com/x/web/archives?status=is_pubing,pubed,not_pubed&ps=3',
+  {credentials: 'include'}).then(r => r.json())).data.arc_audits[0].Archive;
+const x = (await fetch('https://member.bilibili.com/x/vupre/web/archive/view?bvid=' + a.bvid,
+  {credentials: 'include'}).then(r => r.json())).data;
+({ bvid: a.bvid, title: x.archive.title, state: x.archive.state_desc, desc: x.archive.desc.length,
+   tags: x.archive.tag, zone: x.archive.human_type2?.name, parts: x.videos.map(v => v.duration),
+   cover: x.archive.cover })
+```
+
+- `desc` equals the draft length.
+- `tags` are the drafted ones. B站 silently drops some tags (RTX4090, 高性能计算); re-add or replace them.
+- `zone` is 人工智能.
+- `parts` holds one entry within 1 s of the local duration.
+- Download `cover` and look at it.
+- If the video went into a 合集: `x2/creative/web/season/section?id=<section id>` lists this BV last.
+  Shorten its 单集标题 in the 合集 editor, then read the section again to confirm the new title stuck.
+
+**4. 小红书, before 发布:**
+
+```js
+const t = document.body.innerText, ed = document.querySelector('.tiptap.ProseMirror');
+({ title: document.querySelector('input[placeholder="填写标题会有更多赞哦"]').value,
+   file: t.match(/NN_<slug>\.mp4/)?.[0], hd: t.includes('检测为高清视频'),
+   topics: [...ed.querySelectorAll('a.tiptap-topic')].map(a => a.innerText),
+   body: ed.innerText.length, ai: t.includes('笔记含AI合成内容'),
+   mark: t.match(/已添加\d+个标记|标记地点或标记朋友/)?.[0],          // SGLang video: 已添加1个标记
+   cover: [...document.querySelectorAll('[style*="ros-preview"]')].map(e => e.style.backgroundImage.slice(5, -2))[0] })
+```
+
+- The topics are exactly the drafted ones, at the end of the body.

+"""Check the files and the post text before publishing, so nothing wrong goes out.
+
+Run it on the exact files you are about to upload and the exact text you are about to paste. It checks the
+things the sites accept without a word, or that already went wrong once:
+
+  the upload copy is byte-identical to the render you mean to publish (a stale Desktop copy, or the
+      previous video still selected in the file dialog, was uploaded once)
+  the B站 cover is 1440×1080 (4:3)
+  B站 title ≤ 80 characters (the input silently keeps the old value when the text is longer)
+  小红书 title ≤ 20 (ASCII counts half)
+  B站 简介 ≤ 2000 and 小红书 body ≤ 1000 characters
+  B站 简介 carries the AI-voice line (配音为 AI 语音合成)
+  no 「#」 right before a digit in the 小红书 body (it opens the topic popup)
+  no PR status (OPEN / merged / 已合并 ...) in any text
+
+It prints the video's duration and both text lengths: compare them with what the sites show after submit
+(references/publishing.md §Checks).
+
+    $SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/publish_check.py --video ~/Desktop/小红书上传/NN_slug.mp4 \\
+        --render $P/renders/video.mp4 --cover ~/Desktop/小红书上传/NN_slug_封面_B站.png \\
+        --bili-title "..." --xhs-title "..." --bili-desc desc.txt --xhs-body body.txt
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import filecmp
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+STATUS = re.compile(
+    r"\b(OPEN|MERGED|DRAFT)\b|已合并|未合并|待合并|已合入|还没合|review 中|待 review"
+)
+HASH_DIGIT = re.compile(r"#\s*\d")
+AI_VOICE = re.compile(r"AI\s*语音合成|AI\s*配音")
+
+
+def xhs_len(s):
+    """小红书 title length: ASCII counts half."""
+    return sum(0.5 if ord(c) < 128 else 1 for c in s)
+
+
+def text_problems(text, *, xhs):
+    out = []
+    m = STATUS.search(text)
+    if m:
+        out.append(f"PR status in the text: {m.group(0)!r}")
+    if xhs:
+        m = HASH_DIGIT.search(text)
+        if m:
+            out.append(f"「#」 before a digit opens the topic popup: {m.group(0)!r}")
+    return out
+
+
+def probe(path, entries):
+    r = subprocess.run(
+        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries"]
+        + [entries, "-of", "csv=p=0", path],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    return r.stdout.strip().split(",")
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument(
+        "--video", required=True, help="the file you will pick in the dialog"
+    )
+    ap.add_argument("--render", help="the render you mean to publish")
+    ap.add_argument("--cover", help="the 4:3 cover for both sites")
+    ap.add_argument("--bili-title")
+    ap.add_argument("--xhs-title")
+    ap.add_argument("--bili-desc", help="file with the B站 简介")
+    ap.add_argument("--xhs-body", help="file with the 小红书 body")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    bad = []
+
+    def check(ok, msg):
+        print(f"  {'✓' if ok else '✗'} {msg}")
+        if not ok:
+            bad.append(msg)
+
+    dur = float(
+        subprocess.run(
+            ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration"]
+            + ["-of", "csv=p=0", a.video],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=True,
+        ).stdout
+    )
+    print(f"  · video {a.video}: {dur:.1f} s ({int(dur // 60)}:{int(dur % 60):02d})")
+    if a.render:
+        check(
+            filecmp.cmp(a.video, a.render, shallow=False), f"same bytes as {a.render}"
+        )
+    if a.cover:
+        w, h = probe(a.cover, "stream=width,height")
+        check((w, h) == ("1440", "1080"), f"cover {w}×{h} (want 1440×1080)")
+    if a.bili_title is not None:
+        check(len(a.bili_title) <= 80, f"B站 title {len(a.bili_title)}/80")
+        for p in text_problems(a.bili_title, xhs=False):
+            check(False, f"B站 title: {p}")
+    if a.xhs_title is not None:
+        n = xhs_len(a.xhs_title)
+        check(n <= 20, f"小红书 title {n:g}/20")
+    if a.bili_desc:
+        d = open(a.bili_desc, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
+        check(0 < len(d) <= 2000, f"B站 简介 {len(d)}/2000")
+        check(bool(AI_VOICE.search(d)), "B站 简介 has the AI-voice line")
+        for p in text_problems(d, xhs=False):
+            check(False, f"B站 简介: {p}")
+    if a.xhs_body:
+        b = open(a.xhs_body, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
+        check(0 < len(b) <= 1000, f"小红书 body {len(b)}/1000")
+        for p in text_problems(b, xhs=True):
+            check(False, f"小红书 body: {p}")
+    print(f"{'✓' if not bad else '✗'} publish_check: {len(bad)} problem(s)")
+    sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+
+SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "skills" / "sglang-explainer-video" / "scripts"
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("publish_check", SCRIPTS / "publish_check.py")
+C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(C)
+
+
+def test_xhs_title_counts_ascii_as_half():
+    assert C.xhs_len("batch 一大，小 GEMM 为何变慢？") == 15
+    assert C.xhs_len("一行 16 万个 logits，放进寄存器？") == 16.5
+    assert C.xhs_len("一行 16 万个 logits，放进寄存器？再加一点点字数凑") > 20
+
+
+def test_hash_before_digit_only_matters_on_xhs():
+    body = "PR 47683：tiny GEMM，见 #47683"
+    assert any("topic popup" in p for p in C.text_problems(body, xhs=True))
+    assert C.text_problems(body, xhs=False) == []
+    assert C.text_problems("PR 47683 #SGLang #大模型", xhs=True) == []
+
+
+def test_pr_status_is_flagged():
+    assert C.text_problems("这个 PR 已合并，B200 上快 2 倍", xhs=False)
+    assert C.text_problems("Status: OPEN", xhs=False)
+    assert C.text_problems("open-source kernel，合并两个 kernel", xhs=False) == []
+
+
+def test_ai_voice_line():
+    assert C.AI_VOICE.search("中文讲解 + 中英双语字幕；配音为 AI 语音合成。")
+    assert not C.AI_VOICE.search("SGLang PR 47683 讲解，约 13 分钟。")
